branches.conclusion: The official Faculty of Business Administration and Economics inventory places Decision and Operation Technologies under Lehr- und Forschungsbereiche (teaching and research areas). It is not presented as an awarding department, doctoral programme or formal doctoral specialization. BiGSEM separately names its four actual Economics and Management doctoral profiles as Economics, Finance, Management and Data Science; none is a qualifying title. The grammatical singular in the area name is secondary, not the reason for exclusion.

Current Faculty of Technology doctoral overview explicitly awards Dr. rer. nat. or Dr.-Ing. and names only two structured doctoral programmes, Intelligent Systems and Bioinformatics; neither title qualifies. Its full research-group overview lists Intelligent Systems, Bioinformatics and Biotechnology. Faculty of Mathematics current doctoral overview explicitly awards Dr. math. in Mathematics or Dr. phil. in didactics; neither programme or faculty title qualifies. No title-matching Operations, Management Science or Industrial Engineering doctorate or host identified in these official branch inventories.
